errors.text_span: The exact generation lengths are labeled atop each bar
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Exact generation length values are only labeled atop the 'Vanilla CoT' bars. The 'TLDR (Ours)' bars do not have absolute value labels.

The chart does not provide the numerical value '226' for the TLDR bar in the GSM8K group. This value is fabricated. The description repeats this error for all other TLDR bars, hallucinating the values 1400, 6300, and 3380.
The description fails to mention the red percentage labels (-54%, -46%, -7%, -25%) that are explicitly annotated next to each of the 'TLDR (Ours)' bars.
